evals.prompt: Push my current branch to GitHub and open a PR against main. If I'm not logged in to gh, stop and tell me what to do.
evals.expected_output: Checks gh auth first, inspects repo and branch state, uses git push, then gh pr create/status. Does not continue if gh auth fails.

evals.prompt: Pull latest changes from the GitHub remote for this repo. I may have local edits, so don't lose anything.
evals.expected_output: Checks gh auth and repo context, checks dirty worktree before pulling, fetches/prunes safely, uses fast-forward pull or asks about divergence/local changes.

evals.prompt: Look at the failed GitHub Actions run for this branch and summarize the failing job logs. Don't rerun anything.
evals.expected_output: Checks gh auth, uses gh run list/view with failed logs, summarizes failure, and avoids rerun/cancel/dispatch actions.
